verses.text: When Israel departed from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,

xrefs.text: At the end of the 430 years, to the very day, all the LORD’s divisions went out of the land of Egypt.

So Moses told the people, “Remember this day, the day you came out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery; for the LORD brought you out of it by the strength of His hand. And nothing leavened shall be eaten.
They did not realize that Joseph understood them, since there was an interpreter between them.
He ordained it as a testimony for Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt, where I heard an unfamiliar language:
Observe the month of Abib and celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God, because in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night.

verses.text: Judah became God’s sanctuary, Israel His dominion.

xrefs.text: And they are to make a sanctuary for Me, so that I may dwell among them.
You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of Your inheritance— the place, O LORD, You have prepared for Your dwelling, the sanctuary, O Lord, Your hands have established.
But He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.
I will take you as My own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.
And I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant. I will establish them and multiply them, and I will set My sanctuary among them forever.

verses.text: The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back;

xrefs.text: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the LORD drove back the sea with a strong east wind that turned it into dry land. So the waters were divided,
The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and swirled; even the depths were shaken.
Were You angry at the rivers, O LORD? Was Your wrath against the streams? Did You rage against the sea when You rode on Your horses, on Your chariots of salvation?
When the feet of the priests who carry the ark of the LORD— the Lord of all the earth— touch down in the waters of the Jordan, its flowing waters will be cut off and will stand up in a heap.”
who sent His glorious arm to lead them by the right hand of Moses, who divided the waters before them to gain for Himself everlasting renown,

verses.text: the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.

xrefs.text: O LORD, when You went out from Seir, when You marched from the land of Edom, the earth trembled, the heavens poured out rain, and the clouds poured down water.
Mount Sinai was completely enveloped in smoke, because the LORD had descended on it in fire. And the smoke rose like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked violently.
When all the people witnessed the thunder and lightning, the sounding of the ram’s horn, and the mountain enveloped in smoke, they trembled and stood at a distance.
He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains crumbled; the perpetual hills collapsed. His ways are everlasting.
I looked at the earth, and it was formless and void; I looked to the heavens, and they had no light.

verses.text: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,

xrefs.text: Were You angry at the rivers, O LORD? Was Your wrath against the streams? Did You rage against the sea when You rode on Your horses, on Your chariots of salvation?
‘Alas, O sword of the LORD, how long until you rest? Return to your sheath; cease and be still!’

verses.text: O mountains, that you skipped like rams, O hills, like lambs?

xrefs.text: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.

verses.text: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

xrefs.text: Do you not fear Me?” declares the LORD. “Do you not tremble before Me, the One who set the sand as the boundary for the sea, an enduring barrier it cannot cross? The waves surge, but they cannot prevail. They roar but cannot cross it.
He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
If only You would rend the heavens and come down, so that mountains would quake at Your presence,
The foundations of heaven quake, astounded at His rebuke.
Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.

verses.text: who turned the rock into a pool, the flint into a fountain of water!

xrefs.text: He led you through the vast and terrifying wilderness with its venomous snakes and scorpions, a thirsty and waterless land. He brought you water from the rock of flint.
He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.
Then Moses raised his hand and struck the rock twice with his staff, so that a great amount of water gushed out, and the congregation and their livestock were able to drink.
He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
Behold, I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. And when you strike the rock, water will come out of it for the people to drink.” So Moses did this in the sight of the elders of Israel.
